text:
rachel.cs: FYI Cerulean go-live window set for 09:00 PT tomorrow. Need final quota validation, autoscale policy signoff, a 20m soak, and a short customer-facing postmortem template. Also flag: renewal conversation in 10 days, we should capture any onboarding friction. Who can own verification?

tom.eng: I can run the verification and own autoscale validation. What SLOs and burst headroom did AE confirm?

rachel.cs: AE confirmed p95 < 225ms, errors < 0.35%. Customer requested 18% burst headroom for first 25m and a written notes template for renewal talking points. They also asked for a short enablement walkthrough for their infra team.

mina.ops: Quota mapping in portal: us-west-2a=42, us-west-2b=33, us-west-2c=25. Commit tag: cerulean-2026-04-12. Finance pre-approved +1 replica for up to 30m if absolutely needed (id FIN-CER-210).

sam.sre: Recommend start with autoscale policy "slow-lift" for the first 18m (scale_step=1/75s) to reduce JIT/Gc thrash. We'll keep OOM alert thresholds conservative and have pager coverage. Also recommend enabling "prefix-priming" for top traffic prefixes.

tom.eng: Test plan:
- steady: 60% expected QPS for 12m (validate p95/errors)
- burst-ramp: 0->100% over 4m, hold 10m, cool 6m (validate burst/fallback)
Runner: k6 distributed for steady, vegeta for ramp. Example run for ramp:
```bash
echo 'POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate' | vegeta attack -rate=240 -duration=20m | vegeta report
```

rachel.cs: Make sure to capture KV hit-rate, kernel/JIT logs, token-cost delta, and list of any prompts that triggered regressions. We'll include those in the renewal deck as "observability wins" or action items.

ci-bot: Upload complete: s3://redwood-ops/cerulean/bringup/2456789012/steady-v1.tar.gz

tom.eng: Steady results: p95=210ms, errors=0.18%, KV hit-rate=82%, cpu avg 69%. Artifact: https://s3.aws/redwood/cerulean/2456789012/steady-report.zip

tom.eng: Burst ramp (slow-lift) results: short cold window ~55s with p95=410ms while one node JIT'd, then stabilized to 218ms. errors=0.22%. artifacts: https://s3.aws/redwood/cerulean/2456789012/burst-slowlift.zip

tom.eng: Burst ramp (immediate-burst) results: avoided long cold tail but CPU spiked 92% on a host and GC blips observed; p95 peaked 345ms. artifacts: https://s3.aws/redwood/cerulean/2456789012/burst-burstmode.zip

sam.sre: Observations: prefix-priming reduced the cold window by ~30s but didn't fully eliminate kernel JIT on the first active replica. Warm-replica (+1) eliminated the JIT tail but increased short-term token cost ~11%. Quantized fallback (q8) warms faster but we saw a small regression on three prompts.

mina.ops: I can toggle prefix-priming and pre-seed the top 40 prefixes before cutover. I also prepared a temporary +1 slot (portal id quota-CER-210) in case we need the capacity bump.

rachel.cs: Tradeoff notes for AE/renewal deck: priming + slow-lift = lower cost, small initial blip; warm-replica = smoother UX, slightly higher cost for short window. Action: include both options in renewal slide with cost delta estimate. Also capture customer feedback: they want a 1hr enablement session on monitoring hooks and fallback routing.

tom.eng: Recommendation: enable prefix-priming + slow-lift autoscale for first 20m. Auto-fallback: spin +1 warm replica if p95>375ms for >60s and route 5% traffic to q8 fallback if we detect prompt regressions. I'll run final verification at 08:20 PT.

sam.sre: I'll watch 08:50-09:50 PT and lower OOM alerts for the tenant window. Rollback steps added to runbook: revert priming flag, spin warm replica, enable fallback routing, and notify AE+finance if cost cap exceeded. Runbook link: https://confluence.redwood/ops/cerulean-bringup

mina.ops: Prefix-priming toggled in staging and pre-seed job scheduled 08:30 PT. Runbook updated and rollback steps documented. Cost-alert set to notify finance at +$1,000 over expected.

rachel.cs: I'll draft the one-page renewal slide with metrics and two recommended options (cost vs smoothness) and circulate to AE for review before EOD. Also scheduling a 45m enablement demo with the customer's infra lead next Tue. Please add any feedback items you heard during tests to this thread so I can capture them for the AE.

tom.eng: Final artifacts will be uploaded after the 08:20 PT verification. tagging @sam.sre :eyes:

ci-bot: Final upload: s3://redwood-ops/cerulean/bringup/2456789012/final-artifacts.tar.gz

rachel.cs: Thanks team  I'll sync with AE and confirm post-cutover check-in at 11:00 PT. Closing loop after final verification.

mina.ops: Quick feedback item for product/eng: customer asked for a visible "primed" flag in the console that shows which prefixes were seeded and when. They said it would help their ops handoff during renewal talks. Adding ticket to backlog.

tom.eng: Noted. Filing small UX ticket: CONSOLE-PRIME-345.

rachel.cs: Great, capture that in the renewal slide as "enablement ask". Good work everyone. :tada:
